text:
anya: Quick heads-up — ran hybrid-quant bringup for the reranker on holdout-A and seeing seed-dependent NDCG jitter that looks suspiciously like candidate-ordering nondeterminism from retrieval. Dumping notes here.

liam: Numbers? how big is the swing?

anya: NDCG@10: seed=123 -> 0.423, seed=456 -> 0.401, seed=789 -> 0.425. MRR@10 moves ~0.015-0.02. Not huge but reproducible across eval runs.

reina: What does "hybrid-quant" mean here? layers int8 vs fp16 split?

anya: Yes — layers 4..12 are int8, first 3 and last 2 kept fp16. Same weights otherwise. This was the onboarding profile we pushed last night.

sam: Two possibilities: (1) quant numeric noise changing scores, (2) retrieval candidate set/order differences leading to different reranker inputs. If ANN returns slightly different top-k across runs, reranker sees different docs -> ndcg jitter.

liam: Agreed. We saw something similar earlier when index sharding had nondet ordering. Can you reproduce with deterministic retrieval?

anya: Repro steps I used:

```
python eval_run.py \
  --model rerank-v2-hybrid \
  --quant-profile hybrid-v1 \
  --holdout holdout-A \
  --seed 123 \
  --deterministic-ann true \
  --snapshot-index /mnt/indices/holdoutA/snap-2026-03-20
```

Logs show candidate overlap dropping from ~92% (deterministic) to ~78% (non-deterministic) between seeds. Small code snippet of diff:

```
- seed123 top5 ids: [a1, b4, c9, d3, e7]
- seed456 top5 ids: [a1, c9, f2, g8, b4]
```

ops-bot: Deterministic ANN toggle applied to eval harness. Quick smoke: deterministic -> ndcg variance across seeds reduced to <0.003 in a 3-seed sweep.

reina: I'll run a full seed sweep and add a regression alert for this pattern. Also we should sanity-check tokenization/padding parity between offline eval and prod runtime — small differences can cascade.

liam: Also worth checking softmax stability in the quantized kernels (rounding/rescaling). If scores compress differently, tie-breakers change ordering.

anya: Proposed plan:
1) Run seed sweep with deterministic ANN and with non-deterministic ANN but fixed retrieval snapshot.
2) Compute candidate overlap and per-query ndcg deltas; identify whether variance is retrieval or scoring-driven.
3) If retrieval is culprit, we add a deterministic retrieval mode for onboarding/CI. If scoring, run layer-level ablation (int8 candidates vs fp16) and check per-layer contribution.
4) Add regression alert to eval dashboard: trigger when ndcg drop >1.5% and candidate-overlap <85% across sequential runs.

reina: I can own the alert. Naming: `reranker-hybrid-quant-ndcg-jitter`. Threshold: 1.5% ndcg drop sustained over 2 runs, and overlap metric in the payload. I'll add a link to the run artifact in the alert.

sam: :thumbsup: if you can get a minimal repro that shows it's retrieval vs scoring we can decide whether infra (index) or model (quant) teams own the fix.

anya: I'll post the full run artifacts and a short PR to the eval harness by EOD. tagging @reina @liam for visibility.

liam: Thanks — ping here when artifacts are up and I’ll run the kernel-level checks on the quant runtime.

reina: On it. I'll kick off the sweep now and share results in this thread.
